lines.name: Spine crown seam
lines.meaning: S — seam along the top of the rear spine crown

lines.name: Spine segment joint
lines.meaning: O — rear spine segment overlaps the front one

lines.name: Spine edge
lines.meaning: hard edge — raised spine meets the deck shells (C8: raised here)

lines.name: Aft shoulder front edge
lines.meaning: ? — where the aft shoulder wraps forward over the upper shell; TO BE SETTLED BY THE REAR DETAIL DRAWING

lines.name: Upper shell (wing case) edge
lines.meaning: O — the wing case lies over the flank; fades out at the front (open stroke)

lines.name: Flank line
lines.meaning: ? — shallow overlap fading out (C4), not a third plate

lines.name: Head brow crease
lines.meaning: hard edge — top of the head bar, running back into the flank

lines.name: Head underside / collar
lines.meaning: E — underside of the head and the lip above the glass

lines.name: Mid-ship bulge edge
lines.meaning: E — where the buried side bulge emerges from the flank

lines.name: Engine surround opening
lines.meaning: opening edge — the carrier sits inside it
